grammar: phr. 引起；造成。bring sth about 常表示使变化或事件发生。
collocations: bring about change; bring about reform; bring about a result
commonMistake: bring about 后接所引起的结果；过去式和过去分词均为 brought。

example.english: The new railway brought about a major change in village life.
example.chinese: 新铁路给村庄生活带来了重大变化。

application.prompt: The new road has ___ a big change in how people travel. A. brought about B. brought up
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；bring about 表示“引起”，本句指新路改变了出行方式。

grammar: adj. 粗糙的；崎岖的；艰难的。比较级 rougher，最高级 roughest。
collocations: a rough road; rough ground; rough weather
commonMistake: rough 描写路面崎岖或表面不平；指人粗鲁时含义不同，不能一概译作“困难”。

example.english: The bus slowed down on the rough road.
example.chinese: 公共汽车在崎岖的路上减慢了速度。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses rough to describe a road? A. The road was roughly after the storm. B. We drove slowly along a rough road.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；rough 是形容词，可描述崎岖的 road；roughly 是副词。

grammar: phr. 被……覆盖；表面有……。结构为 be covered with + 覆盖物。
collocations: be covered with snow; be covered with dust; a field covered with grass
commonMistake: 主动形式是 cover sth with sth；被动句用 be covered with，主语是被覆盖物。

example.english: After the snowfall, the roofs were covered with white snow.
example.chinese: 下雪后，屋顶上覆盖着白雪。

application.prompt: After the storm, the garden was ___ fallen leaves. A. covered with B. covered from
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；被落叶覆盖用 be covered with，with 后接覆盖物。

grammar: n. 沙尘暴。可数名词，复数 sandstorms。
collocations: a severe sandstorm; a sandstorm warning; during a sandstorm
commonMistake: sandstorm 指强风卷起沙尘的天气；不要与普通的 rainstorm 混用。

example.english: The sandstorm forced the drivers to stop beside the road.
example.chinese: 沙尘暴迫使司机把车停在路边。

application.prompt: A wall of dust moved across the town, and the radio warned of a ___. A. sandstorm B. sunrise
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；大量沙尘席卷城镇说明有 sandstorm（沙尘暴）。

grammar: n. 短缺；不足。常用 a shortage of + 名词。
collocations: a water shortage; a shortage of food; face a shortage
commonMistake: shortage 是可数名词，常说 a shortage of sth；不要漏掉 a 或 of。

example.english: The long dry season caused a shortage of clean water.
example.chinese: 漫长的旱季造成了清洁水短缺。

application.prompt: The village has ___ of drinking water after months without rain. A. short B. a shortage
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；名词短语 a shortage of 表示“……短缺”，句中缺名词。

grammar: n. 耕地；农田，通常作不可数名词。
collocations: protect farmland; farmland near a river; fertile farmland
commonMistake: farmland 指用于耕作的土地，通常不加复数词尾；表示一块地可说 a piece of farmland。

example.english: The new highway was planned to avoid taking too much farmland.
example.chinese: 新公路的规划尽量避免占用过多耕地。

application.prompt: The farmers grow rice on the fertile ___. A. farmland B. factory
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；种植水稻的肥沃土地是 farmland（耕地）。

grammar: n. 缺乏；v. 缺少。名词常接 of，动词 lack 可直接接宾语。
collocations: a lack of sleep; lack confidence; lack experience
commonMistake: a lack of 后接名词；作动词时说 lack sth，不说 lack of sth。

example.english: A lack of buses made the morning journey difficult.
example.chinese: 公交车数量不足让早晨的出行变得困难。

application.prompt: The plan failed because of ___ clean water. A. lacked B. a lack of
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；because of 后接名词短语 a lack of，表示“缺乏”。

grammar: n. 灌木；矮树。可数名词，复数 bushes。
collocations: a rose bush; a thick bush; hide behind a bush
commonMistake: 以 sh 结尾的 bush 变复数加 -es，拼作 bushes。

example.english: A small bird built its nest in the bush by the fence.
example.chinese: 一只小鸟在篱笆旁的灌木丛里筑了巢。

application.prompt: Several ___ grow along the path and provide shade for insects. A. bushs B. bushes
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；bush 的复数形式是 bushes，本句 several 后需复数名词。

grammar: n. 根；根部；根源。可数，复数 roots。
collocations: tree roots; root vegetables; the root of a problem
commonMistake: root 可指植物的根，也可比喻问题的根源；不要与 route（路线）混淆。

example.english: The tree roots held the soil in place during the heavy rain.
example.chinese: 暴雨期间，树根把土壤固定住了。

application.prompt: The gardener carefully covered the young plant's ___ with soil. A. roots B. routes
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；埋进土里的植物部分是 roots（根），routes 表示路线。

grammar: n. 土壤；泥土，表示土地材料时通常不可数。
collocations: rich soil; dry soil; improve the soil
commonMistake: soil 通常不说 a soil 或 soils；形容“脏的”要用 dirty，而 soil 是名词。

example.english: These vegetables grow well in the rich soil near the river.
example.chinese: 这些蔬菜在河边肥沃的土壤里长得很好。

application.prompt: The seeds need warm, wet ___ before they begin to grow. A. soils B. soil
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；此处 soil 指土壤这一材料，通常作不可数名词。

grammar: adj. 含沙的；铺满沙子的。由 sand 加 -y 构成。
collocations: sandy soil; a sandy beach; a sandy path
commonMistake: sand 是名词“沙子”，sandy 是形容词；不要把 sandy 当作名词来用。

example.english: The sandy path was difficult to ride a bicycle on.
example.chinese: 那条沙土路骑自行车很难走。

application.prompt: The wind left the garden with ___ ground that drained water quickly. A. sandy B. sand
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰 ground 要用形容词 sandy，表示“含沙的”。

grammar: n. 政府。可数名词；表示一个国家的政府时常用 the government。
collocations: the local government; government support; form a government
commonMistake: government 可作集体名词，作主语时常按整体用单数谓语；不要漏写词尾 -ment。

example.english: The government built wells to help villages during the drought.
example.chinese: 旱灾期间，政府打井帮助各村庄。

application.prompt: The local ___ has promised to repair the bridge this year. A. govern B. government
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；the local 后需名词 government，句意是地方政府承诺修桥。

grammar: n. 支持；v. 支持；供养。名词前可用形容词，动词直接接宾语。
collocations: support a plan; support local farmers; family support
commonMistake: support 作动词时后直接接支持对象，不用 support to sb；作名词时可说 support for。

example.english: Many families support the market by buying local products.
example.chinese: 许多家庭通过购买本地产品来支持这个市场。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses support correctly? A. Local families support the school garden. B. Local families support to the school garden.
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；support 作动词时直接接宾语 the school garden，不加 to。

grammar: n. 玉米；谷物。表示玉米作物或食物时通常不可数。
collocations: grow corn; a field of corn; corn soup
commonMistake: corn 作食物或作物时通常不加 -s；“一根玉米”可说 an ear of corn。

example.english: The children ate sweet corn after helping in the fields.
example.chinese: 孩子们在田里帮忙后吃了甜玉米。

application.prompt: The farmer planted ___ on the dry land after the rain returned. A. corns B. corn
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；此处 corn 指玉米作物，通常用不可数形式。

grammar: adj. 高科技的；技术含量高的。作名词前定语，通常带连字符。
collocations: high-tech equipment; high-tech farming; a high-tech device
commonMistake: high-tech 是形容词，不能在名词前改成 high-technologically。

example.english: The high-tech greenhouse checks the temperature every minute.
example.chinese: 这座高科技温室每分钟检测一次温度。

application.prompt: The farm uses ___ sensors to water each plant only when needed. A. high-tech B. high-technology
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰名词 sensors 应用形容词 high-tech，意为“高科技的”。

grammar: n. 温室；暖房。可数名词，复数 greenhouses。
collocations: a glass greenhouse; grow tomatoes in a greenhouse; greenhouse effect
commonMistake: greenhouse 是一个合成词，指栽培植物的玻璃或塑料温室；不等于普通的 green house。

example.english: We grew tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
example.chinese: 整个冬天我们都在温室里种番茄。

application.prompt: The seedlings stayed warm inside the glass ___. A. greenhouse B. highway
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；玻璃房内培育幼苗的是 greenhouse（温室）。

grammar: n. 公路；干道。可数名词，复数 highways。
collocations: a busy highway; cross the highway; highway traffic
commonMistake: highway 是供车辆通行的公路；铁路交通用 railway，不要混淆。

example.english: A new highway connects the village with the capital.
example.chinese: 一条新公路把这个村庄和首都连接起来。

application.prompt: The bus left the ___ and turned onto a road leading to the village. A. railway B. highway
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；公交车驶离供汽车通行的公路 highway，railway 是铁路。

grammar: n. 铁路；铁道。可数名词，复数 railways。
collocations: a railway line; railway station; travel by railway
commonMistake: railway 指铁路系统或线路；说“乘火车”常用 by train，而不是 by railway train。

example.english: The railway made it easier for farmers to send vegetables to the port.
example.chinese: 铁路让农民更方便地把蔬菜运到港口。

application.prompt: A passenger train travels along the ___ between the two cities. A. railway B. highway
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；列车行驶在 railway（铁路）上，而不是 highway（公路）上。

grammar: n. 吸引人的事物；吸引力。可数名词；动词为 attract，形容词 attractive。
collocations: a tourist attraction; a popular attraction; tourist attractions
commonMistake: attraction 是名词；句中作谓语要用 attract，不能用 attraction 作动词。

example.english: The old railway station became a popular attraction for visitors.
example.chinese: 这座老火车站成了游客喜爱的景点。

application.prompt: The new science museum is the town's biggest tourist ___. A. attractive B. attraction
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；biggest 后此处需要名词 attraction，指旅游景点。

grammar: n. 产品；制品。可数名词，复数 products；动词 produce 表示生产。
collocations: a dairy product; a new product; product quality
commonMistake: product 是可数名词；produce 可作动词“生产”，也可作农产品总称。

example.english: The company tested its new product before selling it online.
example.chinese: 公司在网上销售新产品前先进行了测试。

application.prompt: The factory introduced a water-saving ___ for small farms. A. product B. produce
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a 后接可数名词 product，指新推出的产品。

grammar: adv. 大大地；非常。常修饰动词或过去分词。
collocations: greatly improve; greatly reduce; be greatly affected
commonMistake: greatly 是副词，修饰动词；great 是形容词，不能直接修饰 increased。

example.english: Better transport has greatly improved access to the city market.
example.chinese: 交通改善大大便利了人们前往城市市场。

application.prompt: Since the railway opened, travel time has ___ decreased. A. great B. greatly
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；greatly 作副词修饰 decreased，表示“显著减少”。

grammar: adj. 社会主义的；n. 社会主义者。作形容词时置于名词前。
collocations: a socialist society; socialist ideas; a socialist
commonMistake: socialist 以 -ist 结尾，可作形容词或指人；socialism 才是“社会主义”这一制度或思想。

example.english: The article describes how a socialist community shared public services.
example.chinese: 这篇文章介绍了一个社会主义社区如何共享公共服务。

application.prompt: The textbook compares ___ ideas with other political systems. A. socialist B. socialism
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰名词 ideas 需要形容词 socialist，而 socialism 是名词。

grammar: n. 电子支付；电子付款。可数名词，复数 e-payments。
collocations: make an e-payment; e-payment service; accept e-payments
commonMistake: e-payment 是名词，前面可用 an；表示支付方式时不要把 payment 写成动词。

example.english: The shop accepts e-payment, so visitors do not need to carry cash.
example.chinese: 这家商店接受电子支付，因此游客不必带现金。

application.prompt: I made ___ for the bus ticket with my phone. A. e-paying B. an e-payment
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；made 后需名词宾语，an e-payment 指一次电子付款。

grammar: n. 住房；住宅供给，通常不可数。
collocations: public housing; housing costs; a housing project
commonMistake: housing 指住房或住房供给，通常不可数；一套房可说 a house 或 a flat。

example.english: The town is building more housing near the railway station.
example.chinese: 镇上正在铁路站附近建造更多住房。

application.prompt: The council plans to provide affordable ___ for young families. A. housing B. houses
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；此处谈可负担的住房供给，用不可数名词 housing。

grammar: adj. 数字的；数码的。名词 digit 指数字，副词 digitally。
collocations: digital payment; digital tools; a digital record
commonMistake: digital 作形容词修饰名词；digit 是数字符号，不能直接说 digit payment。

example.english: Many villagers now use digital services to pay their bills.
example.chinese: 如今许多村民使用数字服务缴费。

application.prompt: The office keeps a ___ copy of every paper receipt. A. digitally B. digital
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；修饰名词 copy 要用形容词 digital。

grammar: adj. 音频的；n. 音频。常作名词前定语。
collocations: audio guide; audio recording; audio equipment
commonMistake: audio 表示声音或音频；表示能听见的形容词是 audible，二者词性和搭配不同。

example.english: The museum offers an audio guide in three languages.
example.chinese: 博物馆提供三种语言的语音导览。

application.prompt: Visitors can listen to the ___ guide while walking around the museum. A. audio B. audible
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；audio guide 是“语音导览”的常见搭配。

grammar: n. 泥土；尘土，通常不可数。形容词 dirty。
collocations: covered in dirt; a dirt road; wash dirt off
commonMistake: dirt 是名词，dirty 是形容词；不能用 dirt 修饰表示“脏”的状态。

example.english: After working in the field, his boots were covered in dirt.
example.chinese: 在田里干活后，他的靴子上沾满了泥土。

application.prompt: The children washed the ___ from their hands before eating. A. dirty B. dirt
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；the 后需要名词 dirt，指手上的泥土。

grammar: n. 小路；轨道；跑道。可数，复数 tracks；也可作动词“跟踪”。
collocations: a dirt track; a railway track; run on the track
commonMistake: track 可指路、轨道或跑道，需结合语境；不要与表示铁路系统的 railway 混为一谈。

example.english: A narrow track leads from the village to the river.
example.chinese: 一条狭窄的小路从村庄通向河边。

application.prompt: The runners waited for the signal beside the school ___ . A. track B. tunnel
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；跑步运动员在跑道 track 旁等待信号。

grammar: adj. 宽的；宽阔的。比较级 wider，最高级 widest；副词 widely。
collocations: a wide road; wide open; a wide range of
commonMistake: wide 是形容词，修饰名词；widely 是副词，不能放在 be 后描述宽度。

example.english: The bridge is wide enough for two lorries to pass.
example.chinese: 这座桥足够宽，能让两辆卡车通过。

application.prompt: The river is too ___ for the children to cross on foot. A. widely B. wide
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；be too 后接形容词 wide 描写河的宽度。

grammar: n. 隧道；地下通道。可数名词，复数 tunnels。
collocations: a railway tunnel; drive through a tunnel; tunnel under a hill
commonMistake: tunnel 作名词时前可加 a；不要将 tunnel 与 tunnel through（挖隧道穿过）混作同一词性。

example.english: The train passed through a long tunnel beneath the mountain.
example.chinese: 火车穿过了山下的一条长隧道。

application.prompt: The road disappears into a ___ and comes out on the other side of the hill. A. tunnel B. tunnelled
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；公路从山的一侧进入并从另一侧出来，穿过的是 tunnel（隧道）。

grammar: n. 联系；交通路线；v. 连接。作动词常用 link A to/with B。
collocations: a direct link; link a village to a city; link between places
commonMistake: 名词 link 后常接 between；动词 link 后可用 to/with，不能漏掉连接对象。

example.english: A new bridge links the port to the capital.
example.chinese: 一座新桥把港口和首都连接起来。

application.prompt: The footpath provides a direct ___ between the station and the market. A. link B. link to
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；direct 后需要名词 link，表示两地之间的联系。

grammar: n. 港口；港口城市。可数名词，复数 ports。
collocations: a busy port; a fishing port; arrive at the port
commonMistake: port 是船只装卸货物的港口；airport 是飞机起降的机场。

example.english: The ship unloaded its cargo at the port before continuing north.
example.chinese: 船在继续北行前先在港口卸下了货物。

application.prompt: The cargo ship reached the ___ before sunset and unloaded its goods. A. porch B. port
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；货船卸货的地点是 port（港口）。

grammar: n. 首都；资本；大写字母。可数，首都义常用 the capital of。
collocations: the capital of Kenya; move capital; capital city
commonMistake: capital 可指首都或资金；表示首都时说 the capital of a country，不说 capital for。

example.english: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
example.chinese: 内罗毕是肯尼亚的首都。

application.prompt: Which sentence identifies a capital correctly? A. Nairobi is the capital of Kenya. B. Nairobi is the capital at Kenya.
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；表示某国的首都用 the capital of + country。

grammar: v. 完成；adj. 完整的。副词 completely；过去式和过去分词 completed。
collocations: complete a form; complete a task; a complete list
commonMistake: complete 作动词表示完成，后直接接宾语；completely 是副词，不能作谓语。

example.english: Please complete the form before you apply for a market stall.
example.chinese: 申请摊位前请填写完这张表格。

application.prompt: Please ___ the online form before Friday so the office can process it. A. completely B. complete
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；情态动词 can 后用动词原形 complete，意为“填完”。

grammar: n. 肯尼亚人；adj. 肯尼亚的。国籍形容词和国民名词均大写，复数 Kenyans。
collocations: a Kenyan farmer; Kenyan culture; many Kenyans
commonMistake: Kenyan 是国籍词，首字母大写；表示语言不能照搬国家名，要说 Swahili 或 English。

example.english: A Kenyan engineer helped design the railway bridge.
example.chinese: 一位肯尼亚工程师参与设计了这座铁路桥。

application.prompt: A ___ farmer showed us how corn is grown near Mombasa. A. Kenyan B. Kenya
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰 farmer 需用国籍形容词 Kenyan，Kenya 是国家名。

grammar: adj. 方便的；便利的。常用 It is convenient for sb to do sth。
collocations: a convenient time; convenient for visitors; find it convenient
commonMistake: convenient 描述安排或地点；表示某人方便常说 convenient for sb，不说 convenient to sb do。

example.english: Paying by phone is convenient for people who do not carry cash.
example.chinese: 对不带现金的人来说，用手机付款很方便。

application.prompt: The new timetable is ___ for farmers who need to reach the market early. A. convenience B. convenient
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；be 动词后作表语需用形容词 convenient。

grammar: n. 生意；商业；事务。可数义“企业”，不可数义“商业活动”。
collocations: do business; a small business; business centre
commonMistake: business 是名词，busy 是形容词；表示企业时可数，表示商业活动时通常不可数。

example.english: Her family runs a small business beside the railway station.
example.chinese: 她家在火车站旁经营一家小生意。

application.prompt: The family opened a small ___ selling farm tools to local villagers. A. business B. busy
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；opened 后接可数名词 business，指一家小企业。

grammar: n. 容易；自在；v. 减轻；缓解。名词常见搭配 with ease。
collocations: with ease; ease the pressure; ease of use
commonMistake: ease 可作名词或动词；easy 是形容词，不能替代名词短语 with ease。

example.english: The new footbridge eased the villagers' daily journey to school.
example.chinese: 新建的人行桥减轻了村民每天上学的路途负担。

application.prompt: The wider footpath brought ___ to the daily walk for older villagers. A. easy B. ease
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；brought 后接名词 ease，表示出行变得更轻松。

grammar: phr. 轻松地；毫不费力地。ease 在此为名词。
collocations: answer with ease; move with ease; complete the task with ease
commonMistake: with ease 是副词性短语，修饰动作；不要说 with easy，easy 是形容词。

example.english: The new train reaches the port with ease, even in bad weather.
example.chinese: 即使天气不好，新列车也能轻松抵达港口。

application.prompt: The lorry crossed the wider bridge ___, without slowing down. A. with ease B. with easy
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；with ease 修饰 crossed，表示卡车“轻松地”过桥。

grammar: n. 卡车（英式英语常用）。可数名词，复数 lorries。
collocations: a delivery lorry; drive a lorry; lorry driver
commonMistake: 以辅音字母加 y 结尾的 lorry 变复数时 y 改 i 加 -es，拼作 lorries。

example.english: A lorry delivered fresh corn to the village market.
example.chinese: 一辆卡车把新鲜玉米送到了村里的集市。

application.prompt: Two ___ brought building materials to the new houses. A. lorrys B. lorries
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；可数名词 lorry 的复数拼作 lorries。

grammar: n. 经理；管理者。动词 manage，名词 manager，管理工作 management。
collocations: a store manager; project manager; manage a team
commonMistake: manager 指管理者，manage 是动词；manager 后常接 of，表示负责的对象。

example.english: The market manager checks the stalls before they open.
example.chinese: 集市经理在摊位开门前进行检查。

application.prompt: The shop ___ orders new stock from local farmers each week. A. manages B. manager
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；主语是 shop，空格处需要谓语动词 manages。

grammar: n. 评论；v. 评论。动词常用 comment on sth。
collocations: make a comment; comment on a plan; comment briefly
commonMistake: comment 作动词时后接 on 引出话题；comment on 不等于直接加人作为宾语。

example.english: The villagers commented on the new bus service at the meeting.
example.chinese: 村民在会上评论了新的公交服务。

application.prompt: At the meeting, several residents ___ on the plan to widen the road. A. comments B. commented
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；several residents 作复数主语，过去时谓语用 commented on。

grammar: n. 结论；总结。常用 draw/reach/come to a conclusion。
collocations: reach a conclusion; in conclusion; final conclusion
commonMistake: conclusion 是名词；动词形式是 conclude，不能说 reach a conclude。

example.english: The report came to the conclusion that the bridge was safe.
example.chinese: 报告得出的结论是这座桥安全。

application.prompt: After checking all the figures, the team reached a ___. A. conclude B. conclusion
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；reach 后接名词 conclusion，表示“得出结论”。

grammar: n. 铁轨；栏杆；铁路运输。表示乘火车可说 by rail。
collocations: by rail; railway rail; hold the rail
commonMistake: rail 是单根铁轨或栏杆；railway 指铁路系统或线路，词义范围不同。

example.english: The old station still has a rail line leading to the port.
example.chinese: 老车站仍有一条通往港口的铁路。

application.prompt: The vegetables were sent to the city ___ because the rail service was fast. A. by rail B. by rails
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；表示“通过铁路运输”用固定搭配 by rail，rail 不加复数。

grammar: adj. 窄的；狭窄的。比较级 narrower，最高级 narrowest；动词可表示使变窄。
collocations: a narrow lane; narrow the gap; narrowly avoid
commonMistake: narrow 作形容词修饰名词；narrowly 是副词，常修饰动词如 narrowly miss。

example.english: The lorry could not enter the narrow lane behind the houses.
example.chinese: 卡车无法驶进房屋后面那条狭窄的小巷。

application.prompt: Only one bicycle can pass through this ___ lane at a time. A. narrowly B. narrow
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；修饰名词 lane 要用形容词 narrow。

grammar: n. 村民。可数名词，复数 villagers；由 village + -er 构成。
collocations: local villagers; a village school; villagers' homes
commonMistake: villager 指住在村子里的人；village 是地点名词，表示人要加 -er。

example.english: A villager showed the visitors the shortest route to the river.
example.chinese: 一位村民给游客指了去河边的最近路线。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses villager to name a person correctly? A. A villager showed us the path. B. A villagers showed us the path.
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a 后用单数 villager；villagers 是复数，不能与不定冠词 a 连用。

grammar: v. 带领；过（某种生活）；n. 领先地位；主角。过去式 led。
collocations: lead a team; lead a life; take the lead
commonMistake: lead 表示“带领”时过去式是 led，不是 leaded；名词 lead 的读音和词义另有不同。

example.english: A local guide will lead the group through the old railway tunnel.
example.chinese: 一位当地向导将带领团队穿过旧铁路隧道。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses lead after will correctly? A. The guide will led the group through the tunnel. B. The guide will lead the group through the tunnel.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；will 后接动词原形 lead，表示导游将带领团队穿过隧道。

grammar: adj. 人造的；非天然的。常置于名词前作定语。
collocations: man-made lake; man-made materials; man-made structure
commonMistake: man-made 指由人建造或制造；handmade 强调手工制作，两者含义不完全相同。

example.english: The man-made lake supplies water to several farms.
example.chinese: 这座人工湖为几个农场供水。

application.prompt: Unlike the natural lake, this ___ reservoir was built by engineers. A. man-made B. natural-made
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；工程师建造的水库是 man-made（人造的）。

grammar: n. 奇迹；令人惊叹的事。可数名词，复数 miracles。
collocations: a miracle of nature; work a miracle; by some miracle
commonMistake: miracle 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a；不要与 medical（医学的）混淆。

example.english: It was a miracle that the village bridge survived the flood.
example.chinese: 村里的桥在洪水中幸存下来真是个奇迹。

application.prompt: The rescue team called the safe return of every passenger a ___. A. mirror B. miracle
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；所有乘客平安归来令人惊叹，称得上 miracle（奇迹）。

grammar: adj. 初级的；低年级的；n. 年少者。常用 junior to sb。
collocations: junior school; a junior student; junior to her sister
commonMistake: junior 作形容词通常放在名词前；比较年龄或级别时用 junior to，不用 than。

example.english: My brother is two years junior to me at school.
example.chinese: 我弟弟在学校比我低两个年级。

application.prompt: Tina is three grades ___ her cousin and studies in the lower school. A. junior than B. junior to
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；表示年级或资历较低用 junior to，而不是 junior than。

grammar: n. 公寓；adj. 平坦的；平淡的。公寓义可数，复数 flats。
collocations: a small flat; rent a flat; a flat roof
commonMistake: flat 作名词可指公寓，作形容词可指平的；不要因词形相同而混淆词性。

example.english: They rented a flat near the new railway station.
example.chinese: 他们在新火车站附近租了一套公寓。

application.prompt: The family lives in a two-bedroom ___ above the bakery. A. flat B. flatly
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a two-bedroom 后需要名词 flat，意为“公寓”。

grammar: n. 讨论；商讨。可数名词，动词为 discuss。
collocations: have a discussion; a discussion about sth; group discussion
commonMistake: discussion 后可接 about 引出主题；动词 discuss 则直接接宾语，不加 about。

example.english: The class had a discussion about how to reduce waste.
example.chinese: 全班讨论了如何减少浪费。

application.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct? A. We discussed about the bus stop. B. We had a discussion about the bus stop.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；名词 discussion 可接 about；动词 discuss 后直接接宾语，不加 about。

grammar: n. 方面；层面。可数名词，复数 aspects。
collocations: an important aspect; every aspect of life; in this aspect
commonMistake: aspect 常与 of 连用指出事物的某一方面；不能把它当作形容词来修饰名词。

example.english: Transport is an important aspect of life in a growing town.
example.chinese: 交通是发展中城镇生活的一个重要方面。

application.prompt: One important ___ of the project is how it will protect farmland. A. aspect B. aspectly
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；important 后接名词 aspect，指出项目的一个重要方面。
